title: Mourning Turned Into Joy
old_p1: Heavenly Father’s people were very sad. Many had been taken far from home. So He gave them a happy picture of what was coming.
“They shall come and sing in the height of Zion,” He said. Zion was the hill in Jerusalem where the temple, Heavenly Father’s holy house, stood. They would come home singing!
old_p2: “Their soul shall be as a watered garden,” He said. A watered garden is green and full of flowers, not dry and thirsty.
Girls would dance, and young men and old men would be glad together. “I will turn their mourning into joy,” He promised. Mourning means feeling very sad when something is lost.
If you felt sad today, Heavenly Father can help your sad turn glad. Snuggle in tonight and feel how loved you are.
p1: Heavenly Father’s people were very sad. Many had been taken far from home.
So Heavenly Father gave Jeremiah a happy promise to share. One day the people would come home. They would sing together on a high hill in Jerusalem.
He said they would be like a watered garden. A dry garden droops, but a watered garden is green and full of life.
p2: Girls would dance, and young men and old men would be glad together. Heavenly Father said, “I will turn their mourning into joy.” Their big, heavy sadness would turn into great big happiness.
Heavenly Father can help a sad heart feel glad again. If you felt sad today, tell Him about it tonight. He loves to comfort you.
